module_summary: 10GBASE-R PHY receive path chaining a SERDES receive interface (descramble, block lock, BER monitor) into a 64b/66b-to-XGMII block decoder.

anchors.name: serdes_rx_data
anchors.why: Scrambled 64-bit SERDES receive block into the rx interface

anchors.name: serdes_rx_hdr
anchors.why: 2-bit sync header accompanying each SERDES block

anchors.name: encoded_rx_data
anchors.why: Descrambled 64b/66b block linking rx interface to decoder

anchors.name: encoded_rx_hdr
anchors.why: Sync header passed from rx interface to decoder

anchors.name: xgmii_rxc
anchors.why: Per-byte XGMII control flags from the decoder

anchors.name: serdes_rx_bitslip
anchors.why: Bitslip request from frame sync to SERDES for block alignment

anchors.name: serdes_rx_reset_req
anchors.why: Watchdog request to reset the SERDES

anchors.name: rx_bad_block
anchors.why: Decoder bad-block flag fed back to rx interface error monitoring

anchors.name: rx_sequence_error
anchors.why: Decoder sequence error flag fed back to rx interface

anchors.name: rx_block_lock
anchors.why: Block lock indication from frame sync

anchors.name: rx_high_ber
anchors.why: High bit-error-rate indication from BER monitor

anchors.name: rx_error_count
anchors.why: Error count output from PRBS/error checking

anchors.name: cfg_rx_prbs31_enable
anchors.why: Configuration input enabling PRBS31 checking in rx interface

groups.name: SERDES rx interface
groups.description: Descrambles SERDES blocks and supervises block lock, BER and errors

groups.name: 64b/66b decoder
groups.description: Decodes encoded blocks into XGMII data/control and flags bad blocks
